name: craft_video
description: Edit existing videos with FilmCraft on an optional self-hosted gateway: trim source in/out ranges, assemble clips, add fitted title text ON the footage or supplied timed captions, and revise saved timeline text overlays. Retains source audio. Returns preview, optional MP4, editable_project_ref, clip/layer IDs and project/media archive. Use action edit with clips for a new cut and video_edits for text; reopen editable_project_ref with video_edits update_text to revise the same timeline. Never substitute a separate title card for text on a video. Use output mp4 for a movie. generate_video is separate AI synthesis.

sources.description: Source videos/images, or one editable_project_ref to reopen the native FilmCraft timeline. Accepts stash://, permitted local paths or craft:// references. External native project uploads are prohibited.

project_id.description: Gateway project ID, inferred from Craft sources when omitted. Reopen the editable_project_ref to retain the native timeline.

width.description: Output width. New edit dimensions fit within 1920x1080 preserving aspect ratio; assemble defaults to 640x360. One explicit dimension derives the other. Reopened timelines retain their size by default; explicit frame changes refit footage and reflow text.

height.description: Output height. New edits preserve source aspect ratio within 1920x1080; assemble defaults to 640x360. One explicit dimension derives the other. Explicit frame changes on revisions refit footage and reflow text.

fps.description: Output frame rate; edit defaults to the source/existing timeline rate.

duration.description: Seconds per clip or title composition.

output.description: png preview or mp4 movie; defaults to png. Request mp4 for video delivery.

project_revision.description: Expected project revision from the prior result; stale writes are rejected.

clips.title: Clips
clips.description: For a new cut, 1..16 ranges in final order. source is the zero-based sources index; start/end are seconds in the SOURCE media. At most 120 seconds total. Omit when reopening a native project. A still image uses start 0 and end equal to its display duration.

video_edits.title: Video Edits
video_edits.description: title and caption add fitted text overlays at start seconds in the EDITED timeline; duration defaults to remaining footage. caption defaults to bottom. update_text selects clip/layer from document.overlays, retaining timing and, if text is omitted, words. Omit timing, echo defaults 0/null, or copy the selected overlay saved start/duration; different timing values are rejected. All captions are supplied text, not automatic transcription.

editable_project_ref.description: For a revision, pass the previous result editable_project_ref here and omit sources. This reopens native layers/timeline; the exported stash_ref is flattened media. Select the layer/clip IDs from document and wait for any running job to finish.

text.title: Text
text.description: Required for new title/caption. Omit on update_text to retain the existing words for placement or style changes.

start.title: Start
start.description: New overlay start in edited timeline seconds. On update_text, omit, echo 0, or copy the selected overlay start from document.overlays. The gateway checks it against the saved clip and retains timing; actual timing changes are unsupported.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: New overlay duration in seconds. On update_text, omit, echo null, or copy the selected overlay duration from document.overlays. The gateway checks it against the saved clip and retains timing; actual timing changes are unsupported.

availability.setup_hint: Run jarvis-craft-tools/setup.sh on the app host, then set CRAFT_API_URL and CRAFT_API_KEY in the selected mode ENV. See jarvis-craft-tools/README.md.
